bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a synthetic multi-turn conversation dataset (USERASSIST) where the 'user' and 'assistant' roles assign conflicting attributes (e.g., symbol-value, object-color) to the same entities, measuring which role's provided information the model preferentially relies on when answering a query.

Measuring whether the model's generated answer aligns more with assignments located close to the end of the conversation (near) versus the beginning of the conversation (far), regardless of the user-assistant role tags.
